title: Filipino Style Earthy Stir Fry
description: A hearty, earthy stir fry with a mix of vegetables and Filipino flavors. This dish is easy to make and packed with nutrients.

ingredients.name: Filipino-style soy sauce
ingredients.notes: or regular soy sauce as substitute

instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides.
Remove the tofu and set aside.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the bok choy and cook until wilted.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and ginger. Stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the wok and stir to combine.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
